[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import data.list.basic
import data.real.basic

def implementation (numbers: List Rat) (threshold: Rat) : Bool :=
let rec loop (i: Nat) : Bool :=
  match i with
  | 0 => false
  | i + 1 =>
    let j := i - 1
    if j < 0 then
      false
    else
      let diff := (numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j).abs
      if diff < threshold then
        true
      else
        loop j
loop numbers.length
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation numbers threshold
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  intros h_numbers_len
  have h_loop := loop.result numbers.length
  by_cases h_result: result
  -- Case 1: result = true
  simp [h_result]
  simp [h_loop]
  simp [Nat.add_one]
  simp [Nat.sub_one]
  apply And.intro
  -- numbers_within_threshold
  use i - 1, i
  apply And.intro
  -- 0 < i - 1 < numbers.length
  have h_i_pos: 0 < i - 1 := by linarith
  have h_i_lt_len: i - 1 < numbers.length := by linarith
  exact h_i_pos, h_i_lt_len
  have h_diff_lt_threshold: |numbers.get! (i - 1) - numbers.get! i| < threshold := by
    simp [h_loop]
  -- 0 < numbers.length
  have h_numbers_len_pos: 0 < numbers.length := by linarith
  exact h_numbers_len_pos, h_diff_lt_threshold
  -- Case 2: result = false
  simp [h_result]
  simp [h_loop]
  simp [Nat.add_one]
  simp [Nat.sub_one]
  apply And.intro
  -- ¬numbers_within_threshold
  intro i j h_i_j
  have h_i_j_i: i ≠ j := by
    simp at h_i_j
    exact h_i_j
  have h_i_j_len: i < numbers.length ∧ j < numbers.length := by
    simp at h_i_j
    exact h_i_j
  have h_diff_ge_threshold: |numbers.get! i - numbers.get! j| ≥ threshold := by
    simp at h_i_j
    exact h_i_j
  -- 0 < numbers.length
  have h_numbers_len_pos: 0 < numbers.length := by linarith
  exact h_numbers_len_pos, h_i_j_i, h_i_j_len, h_diff_ge_threshold
  -- 0 < numbers.length
  simp [h_numbers_len]
  exact h_numbers_len_pos
[END]
